limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Qualitative compactness and strict-singularity facts for multiplication operators, including basic statements for restrictions to compact-operator spaces, are prior art and are not claimed as new. The quantitative result is restricted to normalized symmetrically normed Banach ideals contained in K(H) on separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space; it does not cover quasi-Banach ideals or general sums of elementary operators. For two noncompact coefficients the stated essential-norm quantity is only proved to be a lower bound, not always an exact value.
provenance: A spectral tail below a coefficient's Hilbert-space essential norm supplies an infinite-dimensional subspace on which that coefficient is bounded below. Rank-one columns or rows over this subspace form explicit 1-complemented Hilbertian subspaces of every normalized symmetrically normed Banach ideal; their images are likewise 1-complemented. These witnesses give the four s-number lower bounds and strict-singularity distance bounds, while compact-factor approximation gives exactness in the stated cases.
record_title: Flat classical s-number profiles for one-sided multiplication on symmetric norm ideals
